text: dsh-deepseek-cny-cost 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的会话费用估算插件。它在聊天输入栏工具行注册费用徽标，读取当前会话的 tokenUsage 和 modelSelection 投影，依据 DeepSeek 模型单价、北京时间高峰时段与节假日规则计算人民币金额。徽标显示整段聊天的累计估算，悬停可查看未命中输入、缓存命中输入和输出的用量及费用明细；缓存写入计入未命中输入，并兼容旧版 Flash 模型名。缺少投影、非 DeepSeek 路由或模型无价格时显示诊断占位。适合希望在 DSH 网页聊天中了解 DeepSeek 费用的用户，无需额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-deepseek-cny-cost estimates DeepSeek chat costs in CNY in the DSH web composer. It reads token usage and model selection, applies peak or off-peak rates, and shows a cost breakdown on hover. No extra key or service is needed.
想在 DSH 聊天时直接看到 DeepSeek 会话大概花了多少人民币。
DSH 能不能按当前模型和 token 用量估算聊天费用？
希望在输入框旁查看缓存命中、输入和输出分别产生的费用。
想知道 DeepSeek 的费用在高峰时段和非高峰时段有什么区别。
Show me an approximate CNY cost for my current DeepSeek chat in DSH.
Can I see a breakdown of cached input, uncached input, and output costs in the web composer?
Estimate what my DeepSeek conversation has cost so far.
Show peak and off-peak DeepSeek pricing in my DSH chat.
dsh-deepseek-cny-cost 的功能「会话费用徽标」：在 DSH 聊天输入栏旁显示当前会话的人民币费用估算；悬停可查看未命中输入、缓存命中及输出费用明细。
dsh-deepseek-cny-cost 的功能「峰谷价格计算」：按北京时间工作日时段及内置节假日表选择峰值或半价，并按模型单价估算输入与输出费用。
dsh-deepseek-cny-cost 的功能「模型兼容与诊断提示」：把两个旧 Flash 模型名映射到 Flash 价格；缺少投影、选中非 DeepSeek 路由或模型无价格时显示占位提示。
dsh-deepseek-cny-cost 使用前须知：金额是估算，不含按次收费的 Search / Fetch；若聊天曾切换模型，整个聊天用量会按当前选中模型计价。
dsh-deepseek-cny-cost 使用前须知：内置法定节假日表仅覆盖 2026 年；其他年份只按周末判断，因此未录入年份的工作日节假日会按高峰价估算。

dsh-deepseek-cny-cost README · dsh-deepseek-cny-cost：**See what the chat you are reading has cost, in CNY, inside the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.**

A small badge sits under the composer next to the session statistics:

```
≈¥0.0123
```

dsh-deepseek-cny-cost README · How it prices：It reads two projections the session already exposes and issues no requests of its own:

| Data | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Token usage | `tokenUsage` (`uncachedInputTokens`, `cacheReadTokens`, `cacheWriteTokens`, `outputTokens`) |
| Current model | `modelSelection` |

Prices come from the official [Models & Pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing) page (checked 2026-10), in CNY per million tokens:

dsh-deepseek-cny-cost README · How it prices：| Model | Cache hit | Cache miss | Output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deepseek-flash` | 0.04 | 2 | 8 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | 0.30 | 9 | 27 |

Those are **peak** rates. Off-peak is half of peak; peak is Beijing time Monday–Friday (excluding Chinese statutory holidays) 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, and every other hour — weekends and holidays included — is off-peak.

dsh-deepseek-cny-cost README · Known limits：- **An estimate, not an invoice.** It excludes per-request Search / Fetch charges; the official bill wins.
- **Chats that switched models** are priced with the currently selected model, because `tokenUsage` is a whole-chat total with no per-model split.
- **Holidays**: the built-in table covers 2026. A year without an entry falls back to weekends only, so its holiday weekdays would be priced as peak.
- Shown for DeepSeek official providers (`deepseek-official`, `deepseek-account`, or any new provider id starting with `deepseek`).

dsh-deepseek-cny-cost README · Install：Desktop: **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter the **absolute path of this directory** (the installer records a `link:` dependency), then install and enable. Restart DSH completely if it asks, then refresh the page.

Command line, for a non-desktop profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-deepseek-cny-cost
```

dsh-deepseek-cny-cost README · Develop：```bash
node --check client.js
node tools/test-cny-cost.mjs   # pricing, peak windows, formatting, slot registration, component behavior
```

`client.js` is the whole browser half: a lazy factory registered through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`, with React supplied by the host module table. To make an edit take effect, remove the bundle and install it again from the same source (`ambiguous-install` otherwise).
